en: The soldier is yellowish brown with slightly paler antennae and a pale yellowish white thorax, abdomen and legs, while the front margin of the pronotum is brown. The head is almost bare; the tip of the nasus carries four long setae and several short ones, two long setae stand behind the vertex, and four longitudinal rows of hairs run between the abdominal tergites. Neither alate nor worker is described in the source.
soldier: 兵蚁头部黄褐，触角色泽稍淡，胸、腹部及足淡黄白，前胸背板前缘褐色。头部近于光裸，象鼻末端生有四枚长毛与数根短毛，头顶后方具二枚长毛，腹部背板之间列有四行纵毛。
